hypothesis: v19/v21 payoff regression was near the past-action constant and action rank correlation was weak. Keep causal TCN+attention but reduce capacity and replace MSE with Huber plus a fixed pairwise utility-ranking term against a synthetic WAIT action. The policy and cost model remain unchanged.
selection: Fixed8 epochs, all3 seeds x11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed or fold selection and no threshold/portfolio tuning. Ranking tie/temperature and loss weights are versioned here before training. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, net, coverage and fills. No live approval.
compute: Private free Kaggle T4x2 only for heavy training; local GTX1650 inference/replay/backtests. Do not mutate v19/v21 exports.
